title: Voter ID Online Form 2024, E EPIC Download
postName: New Voter Registration, Correction & e-EPIC Download
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://voters.eci.gov.in
2. Login / create account with mobile
3. Form 6 for new voter or Form 8 for correction
4. Upload photo and documents
5. Download e-EPIC after approval; search name in roll
shortDescription: Voter ID Online Form & e-EPIC Download – register, correct details and download digital Voter ID on voters.eci.gov.in.
content:
The Election Commission of India Voter Portal allows online voter registration, correction, deletion/shifting requests and e-EPIC download.

  • Form 6 – New registration (18+ years)
  • Form 8 – Correction / migration
  • Download digital EPIC PDF

Portal: voters.eci.gov.in.
